pricing_source: OpenRouter /api/v1/models, retrieved 2026-09-06; prices are preserved in harness.py
evaluation_set: 50 cases (30 ordinary x1 trial + 20 negative x3 trials = 90 trials), current as of 2026-09-09. All five D5(b) models plus the D2(b) v1/v2 pair below are re-run against this set.
original_batch_note: The first live measurements (run_date 2026-09-06) used an earlier 40-case batch (20 ordinary x1 + 20 negative x3 = 80 trials). All canonical_live_runs below have since been re-run against the current 50-case set. The ranking shifted materially on re-measurement: deepseek-v4-flash moved from third to first (91.25% -> 98.9%, now cheapest and most accurate), and gemini-2.5-flash dropped from 96.25% to 93.3%.
supplementary_metric: strict case consistency; every trial for a case must pass

canonical_live_runs.purpose: D2b return-shape v1 (prose, descriptor pinned at v2)
D2b return-shape v2 (typed JSON, descriptor pinned at v2)

prompt_fingerprint_note: prompt_sha256 is sha256(config.build_system_prompt()) for v2 rows, sha256(config.build_system_prompt(descriptors_v1.OVERRIDES)) for the v1 row - computed 2026-09-09 from the current, committed config.py and descriptors_v1.py, not captured contemporaneously at each original run. This is an honest limitation, not a claim of live capture: the fingerprint is retroactive, valid because the rendered prompt text has not changed since (verified by matching character count, 8661 for v2) and reproducible by any marker via `python3 -c "import config,hashlib; print(hashlib.sha256(config.build_system_prompt().encode()).hexdigest())"`. harness.py --live now prints this same hash for every future run, so this gap does not recur going forward.

verification_commit.note: HEAD at the time this manifest was last updated, not a per-run historical commit (none were captured contemporaneously).
